title: Lula Warns UN General Assembly Against Foreign Interference in October Election
detail: Addressing the UN General Assembly, President Lula said Brazil would not allow domestic or foreign actors to undermine the October 4 vote, declaring 'Brazilian democracy belongs to Brazilians' and warning against a resurgence of great-power 'hegemonic ambitions' toward Latin America. The remarks followed two rounds of Trump administration tariffs on Brazilian goods and Lula's accusation that Washington — an ally of his rival Flávio Bolsonaro — was using economic pressure to influence the election.

media.caption: Lula warns against foreign interference and defends Brazil's sovereignty at the UN
